language.lore: A withering wind.
description: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
language.aghanimDescription: Grants 1 current and max level.

language.lore: An exacting flame.
description: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
language.aghanimDescription: Grants 1 current and max level.

description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

language.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.
description:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.

Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

language.lore: Sadron's Protracted Frisson.
description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than 10.0 after reductions.

language.lore: Myrault's Hinder-Gast.
description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

language.lore: Claws of Tornarus.
description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

language.lore: Endoleon's Malevolent Perturbation.
description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

language.lore: Gaster's Mandate of Impetuous Strife.
description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.

language.lore: Tarak's Descent of Fire.
description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every 0.5 seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over 3.0 seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of 300.

language.lore: Harlek's Incantation of Incineration.
description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

language.lore: Culween's Most Cunning Fabrications.
description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

language.lore: Killing Wall of Koryx.
description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.

language.lore: Buluphont's Aureal Incapacitator.
description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.

language.lore: Nortrom's lack of incantations is less of a problem for him than it is for his adversaries.
description: Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemy heroes to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed. Silenced enemies take 1.25x slow and damage. Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes: Affects creeps.

language.lore: Although lacking in traditional incantations, Nortrom's pedigree of the Aeol Drias gives him uncanny wisdom, which he applies to physical combat.
description: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

language.lore: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.
description: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

description: If Silencer kills an enemy hero, he permanently steals Intelligence.
notes: To permanently steal Intelligence, Silencer doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death.
language.shardDescription: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.

language.lore: With a shock to the ground, all magic and sound pauses, and Nortrom fulfills his prophecy.
description: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
notes: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.
language.aghanimDescription: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

language.lore: Harbinger's outworldly knowledge allows it to tap into the ebb and flow of all spiritual energy, infusing it into his being.
description: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.

language.lore: Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.
description: Places a target unit into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target and steals a percentage of their max mana.
notes: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
language.shardDescription: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at 0 movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

language.lore: The Outworld is awash in arcane energy, inclined to diffuse through any of Harbinger's rifts.
description: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability.
notes: Break prevents the Aghanim's Scepter effect from triggering.
language.aghanimDescription: Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20 health triggers a strong dispel. In addition, when the effect is triggered Outworld Destroyer consumes of all his mana to create an all damage barrier equal to 65 of his maximum mana that lasts for 12 seconds. This effect can occur every 80 seconds and cannot be refreshed.

description: Outworld Destroyer gains an additional 2.5 mana per point of Intelligence.

language.lore: When an Outworld crystal ruptures, cataclysmic energies are released, and the reverberations of this power are felt interdimensionally.
description: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your mana and the target's mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

language.lore: The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.
description: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
language.shardDescription: Causes one of your creep waves to include one uncontrollable wolf that moves with the wave. Additionally, wolves spawned this way may Cripple towers.

language.lore: Blood-curdling wolf cries signal to opponents that Banehallow is among them.
description: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

language.lore: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.
description: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

language.lore: Does this bite look infected?
description: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
notes: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

description: Lycan and units he controls deal 2% extra damage to neutral creeps per hero level.

language.lore: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.
description: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.
notes: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.

language.lore: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.
description: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

language.lore: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!
description:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.

language.lore: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.
description:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

description: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.
language.shardDescription:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting 0 Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts 0 seconds.

language.lore: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.
description: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
notes: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
language.aghanimDescription:
Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

language.lore: The pain of deception comes not while it happens, but when it is revealed.
description: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

language.lore: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.
description: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.

language.lore: The ever growing influence of the Shadow Demon can pollute the most valiant and pure of heroes.
description: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 50 damage each. This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

description: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

language.lore: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.
description:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

language.lore: Once Shadow Demon no longer has any need for his collected cultist, he releases it from its subservience - and its life.
description: Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: The slow starts at 100% and decreases over time to 20%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain  charges.

description: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking 2.5% Amplify Damage debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

description:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
language.aghanimDescription: Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

language.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
language.aghanimDescription:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for 20s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by 35. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

 The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.

language.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.
description: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
language.shardDescription:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.
description:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20.0% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

language.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.
description: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
notes: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Lone Druid was in when the item was used.

language.lore: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
description: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
notes: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
language.shardDescription: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 0 less damage.

language.lore: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.
description: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. Reduces armor of the enemy unit for 6 seconds.
notes: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
language.shardDescription: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

language.lore: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.
description: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a 50% chance that an additional 1 extra illusion will spawn.

language.lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.
description: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
language.aghanimDescription: Creates an illusion of allied heroes globally. Creates an additional illusion for Chaos Knight as well.

language.lore: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.
description: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

language.lore: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind.  Or your other self.
description:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.
language.aghanimDescription: Each additional Meepo in the tower when poofing increases the damage done by %

language.lore: So you gonna need that, or...?
description: Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.
notes: Amount healed is amplified by Lifesteal Amplification

language.lore: I'm diggin' here!
description:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: Hi, Meepos!
description: Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.
When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals bonus damage based on the amount of Meepos riding on top.

language.lore: Do I know you?
description: Meepo summons an imperfect, semi-autonomous duplicate of himself, which can gain gold and experience as he does and shares his experience, attributes and abilities. However, the clones cannot wield any items but the boots that Meepo himself wears.  If any of the clones die, they all die. Divided We Stand grants all Meepos bonus Magic Resistance.
notes: Of boot abilities, clones can only use the active ability from Phase Boots.
language.shardDescription: Divided We Stand can be cast as long as there's a Meepo within %fling_radius% radius of yourself. Causes that Meepo to fling you towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed. Mana Cost: %AbilityManaCost%

language.lore: You go first!
description: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

description: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

language.lore: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.
description: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.

language.lore: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.
description: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit, dealing additional magic damage. The unit is then bound for a short duration and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on a flat amount and the damage dealt by the attack.

language.lore: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.
description: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes: Instances of damage less than 20 are ignored.
language.shardDescription: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for  seconds.

language.lore: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.
description: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 300 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

language.lore: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.
description: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

language.lore: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.
description: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.
language.aghanimDescription: Decreases Cooldown to 110 100 90 seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, gaining an undispellable buff that greatly increasing his size for  seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of ,  bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals  of his attack damage in a  unit radius.

language.lore: The Ogre Magi is easily amused, entertained for hours by playing with fire.
description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.

language.lore: Batter up!
description: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a 1400 area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

language.lore: 'Running's not as fun as hitting... Not one bit fun.'
description: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attacks speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 700 area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

language.lore: The 'who-casts-spell-first' argument between himself is solved simply by both casting at once.
description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.

language.lore: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.
description: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 1000 area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

description: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

language.lore: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magi's success in battle is attributed to pure skill.
description: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use.
notes: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.

language.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
description: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2.0x damage to creeps.
notes: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases strength steal.

language.lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.
description: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.

language.lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
description: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
notes: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
language.shardDescription: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for 2 seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for 2 seconds.

language.lore: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.
description: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.

language.lore: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.
description: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. Gains a percentage increase to strength and imbues attacks with a slow and damage amplification.

language.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
description: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
language.shardDescription: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw range is  longer and throw delay is reduced to  seconds.

language.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.
description: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack damage. Each jump deals less damage.

language.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
description: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and increased potency.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new Arcane Accumulation stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing Arcane Accumulation stacks.

description: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.
Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

language.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
description: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies, and stolen spells last longer on enemies.
notes: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades spells to their Scepter version.

description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
Each 1 Spell Amplification also increases Rubick's attack damage by 0.75% and Magic Resistance by 0.75%.
Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

language.lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.
description: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.3 seconds. Provides vision of its target.
language.shardDescription: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to 4 seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

language.lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.
description: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4.0 / 4.0 / 4.0 / 4.0 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

language.lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
description: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.

language.lore: Safe harbor found inside the storm.
description: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within are pushed back up to a 400 unit distance.
notes: After 7s, the damage counter is reset.

language.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.
description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
language.aghanimDescription: Mutes items.

language.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.
description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes: The spikes move at 1600 units per second, over 750 range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

language.lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.
description: Deals damages to the enemy equal to a percentage of its Max Mana. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

language.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.
description: When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.
While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled units.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.

language.lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.
description: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

description: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within 400 units of himself.

language.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.
description: Allows Nyx Assassin to become invisible and gain a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes: Has a 0.0 second fadetime.
If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
language.shardDescription: Vendetta applies Break on attack.

language.lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.
description: Emerge from the burrow.

language.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.
description: Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Naga Siren is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

language.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.
description: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

language.lore: Even the youngest Slithereen are well schooled in trawling for prey with nothing but their wits and nets.
description: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.
language.aghanimDescription: Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

description: Naga Siren gets 8% evasion per other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

language.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Allies in range recover a percentage of their health per second. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
notes: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
language.shardDescription: Increases Song of the Siren's regen and adds mana regeneration for allies.

description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

language.lore: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.
description: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

language.lore: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.
description: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back and blinding the units in the area, causing them to miss some attacks. Knockback is 400 range over 0.6 seconds.
notes: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

language.lore: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.
description: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.
notes: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities

language.lore: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.
description: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

language.lore: In a flash of light, Ezalor reveals his true nature.
description: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining bonus movement speed, cast range, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
language.shardDescription: Increases illuminate heal.

description: Release the channel early.
Keeper of the Light cannot go below 75 mana.

language.lore: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.
description: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, he will latch on and pull himself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
language.shardDescription: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 0% of the damage done.

language.lore: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.
description: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
language.aghanimDescription: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

language.lore: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.
description: Io gains health regeneration based on max health.  If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.
Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

language.lore: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.
description: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

description: Break the link to the tethered unit.
Io regenerates from consumables and certain items 2x faster.
notes: Total amount of restored health or mana remains the same.
Only applies to Healing Salve, Tango, Clarity, Bottle, Urn of Shadows, Spirit Vessel, Mana Draught, and Pollywog Charm.

language.lore: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.
description: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining it for itself and nearby familiars.
notes: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

language.lore: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.
description: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes: Charges are only gained for damage greater than 2.0 and less than 3000.0 that is dealt by a player or Roshan. Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
attributes: BONUS GOLD PER CHARGE PER KILL: 0

language.lore: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.
description: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.
notes: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
language.shardDescription: Grants Visage the ability to cast Gravekeeper's Cloak. Restores up to  of your health.

language.lore: There is no weapon or spell devised that can mar the wroughtstone servants of death.
description:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6.0 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.
notes: While Stone Form is not dispellable, the stun can be removed by strong dispels.

language.lore: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.
description: Turns Visage and familiars invisible, granting Visage bonus movement speed and upgrading its movement type to flying. When Visage or its familiars leave invisibility they deal more damage for a short duration. Lasts 30 seconds. Invisibility ends when attacking or casting.

language.lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.
description: Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed.
notes: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.

description:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6.0 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every 2.0s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants 2.0% cooldown acceleration with a max of 8 stacks. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
Affects Visage's ability cooldown durations, including spells already on cooldown.

language.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
description: After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: 1.5% seconds after cast, a series of 10 pulses separated by 0.1 seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.

language.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
description: Slark leaps forward, leashing the first hero he connects.  That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of 933.33, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled 700 distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
language.aghanimDescription: Provides charges and increases range.

description: Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.  This effect stacks.
notes: Subsequent use of Saltwater Shiv refreshes the duration of all Shiv stacks.

language.lore: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.
description: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

language.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
description: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.
notes: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

language.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.
description:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2.0 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

language.lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
description: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.
The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
notes: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
language.aghanimDescription: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

language.lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.
description: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.

language.lore: The best predators don't even need to pounce.
description: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

language.lore: Point your gaze at her if you dare.
description: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.

language.lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.
description: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana that increases with each level of Medusa. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.
notes: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

language.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
description: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed. If 2.0 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone. Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

language.lore: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.
description: Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. Melee attacks have decreased base attack time.

language.lore: Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.
description: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950.0 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
notes: Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
language.aghanimDescription:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: Keep your enemies close.
description: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
notes: Does not affect Roshan.
language.aghanimDescription:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.
description: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
language.shardDescription: Grants Troll  +  chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus  when attacking an enemy unit.

language.lore: Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.
description:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed and armor.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
notes: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Troll Warlord was in when the item was used.

language.lore: An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.
description: Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.

language.lore: When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.
description: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

language.lore: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.
description: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
notes: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
language.shardDescription: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of  stacks.

language.lore: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.
description: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.

language.lore: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.
description: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

language.lore: The needs of Bradwarden's ample pride pale greatly in the face of his demand for victory.
description: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

language.lore: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.
description: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
Permanently gain 25 max health every 120.0s.

language.lore: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.
description: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

language.lore: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.
description: Gives an allied unit bonus damage and cleave on attack. Magnus receives 30% larger bonus.
notes: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.

language.lore: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.
description: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
language.shardDescription: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

language.lore: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.
description: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
Magnus has slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

language.lore: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.
description: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

language.lore: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.
description: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.

language.lore: You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.
description: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.

language.lore: The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.
description: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
language.aghanimDescription: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and  damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw  +  barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within  radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of . After  seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within  radius equal to  + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.

language.lore: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.
description: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

language.lore: The ultimate in anti-flora weaponry.
description: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted. While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
notes: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over 2000.0 distance away.

description: Returns the Chakram to Timbersaw.
Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 mana.

language.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.
description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5.0 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

language.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
description: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14.0 seconds.
notes: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

language.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
description: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes 275 / 250 / 225 / 200 damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
notes: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
language.aghanimDescription: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40.

language.lore: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.
description: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

language.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
notes: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

description: Bristleback has 10% damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

language.lore: In the frozen tundra near the Barrier, after the last sun of autumn has set, ice can form with alarming speed.
description: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 seconds.
notes: Creates an impassable barrier.
language.shardDescription: Increases depth of Ice Shards, and enemies trapped within an ice shard are slowed and take damage per second.

language.lore: Tales are still told of the wild feat that ended the grand brawl at White Fields.
description: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
notes: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.

language.lore: Tusk may have made his name with his fists, but the wise enemy is wary of any and all limbs.
description: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.
Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within 350 radius by 20 / 40 / 60 / 80.

language.lore: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.
description: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
notes: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.

language.lore: Into the great wide white!
description: Launch the snowball toward the target.
notes: The snowball destroys trees.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.

language.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
notes: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.
language.shardDescription: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, 1 bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

language.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
notes: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
language.aghanimDescription: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within  range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

language.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
notes: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
language.aghanimDescription: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within  range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

description: Skywrath Mage has 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% Spell Lifesteal.

language.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2.0 seconds.
notes: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Spell immune enemies do not count toward the damage distribution.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
language.aghanimDescription: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within  range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

language.lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.
description: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
notes: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.

language.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
description: Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
language.shardDescription: 0 of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

language.lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.
description: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.
Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5.0s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 35% if they are below 40.0 HP.

language.lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
description: When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than  damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

language.lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.
description: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
notes: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
language.shardDescription: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

language.lore: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.
description: Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage, armor, and movement speed for each unit it passed through.
The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for  seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

language.lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.
description: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.

description: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

language.lore: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.
description: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.
Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal 100% bonus damage.

language.lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.
description: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area. Also grants bonus Attack Speed to Legion Commander. Can be cast during Duel.
language.shardDescription: Gives  bonus radius when cast during Duel.

language.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.
description: Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

language.lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.
description: When attacked, Legion Commander has a chance to immediately counterattack with bonus lifesteal.
Attacking an enemy hero that is equal or higher level than you increases your Health Restoration by 30 / 40 / 50 / 60% for 4.0s.

language.lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.
description: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration.
