Neither hero can use items or abilities, with the exception of Legion Commander being able to cast Overwhelming Odds. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
notes: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
language.shardDescription: Increases Duel damage by  per win. Applies retroactively.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases Duel duration.  Legion Commander is debuff immune for the duration of the Duel.

language.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.
description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.

language.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.
description: Techies trigger an electric charge giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking Techies are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel. At the end of the effect, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius.
language.shardDescription: Reactive Tazer can be cast on allies and deals damage on detonation. Also deals damage to any enemy that attacks the affected ally.

language.lore: Where we going?
description: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
notes: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.
language.shardDescription: Increases Blast Off! cast range by %shard_bonus_cast_range% and applies a %shard_stun_duration% second stun to affected enemies.

language.lore: Watch your step!
description: Plant a warning sign, causing Sticky Bombs and Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 60 seconds.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases radius and duration of Minefield Sign. When an enemy hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 500 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy units any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

language.lore: The bane of Toterin!
description: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1.0 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases up to 60 on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.
notes: Cannot be placed within 350 AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

description: Detonate Reactive Tazer immediately.

language.lore: Xin's harshest lessons often employed the use of red-hot chains.
description: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
notes: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

language.lore: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.
description: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
notes: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every 0.25 seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.

language.lore: An enemy should never be allowed to approach without difficulty.
description: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
notes: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after application.

language.lore: With blazing speed does a spirit fly!
description: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
language.shardDescription: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage and radius.

language.lore: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.
description: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant. Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
notes: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
language.shardDescription: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

language.lore: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.
description: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits. If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

language.lore: Calling upon his connection to the land, the Earth Spirit draws loose stone to him, which forms a protective ball that he can use to roll short distances.
description: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of 160.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

language.lore: Like calls to like. Even the minerals found in the blood and bones of living beings are not immune to the call of the Earth Spirit.
description:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
notes: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
language.shardDescription: Decreases cooldown to 13s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

language.lore: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.
description:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 2.5% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5 bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

language.lore: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.
description:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. < br>
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

language.lore: At the Earth Spirit's call, the minerals in the blood and bones of his enemies rebel against the bodies they find themselves in.
description: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

language.lore: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.
description: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
language.shardDescription: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

language.lore: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.
description: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases radius of the Pit of Malice.

language.lore: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.
description: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new stacks.

description: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

language.lore: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
description:
Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.

Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain.
language.aghanimDescription: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

language.lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.
description: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
notes: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.

language.lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade.  Facing MORE Terrorblades!
description: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
notes: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.

language.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control.  Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.
description: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within 1200 range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
notes: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

language.lore: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.
description: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Reflection illusions gain 50% of the bonuses. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal

language.lore: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.
description: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

language.lore: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.
description: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
notes: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.

description: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
notes: Reflection Illusions are also affected.

language.lore: Though no stranger to travelling the cosmic void, soaring within an atmosphere offers unique pleasures.
description: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
notes: Icarus Dive has a 2.0 second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

language.lore: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.
description: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
language.shardDescription: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.

language.lore: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.
description: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
notes: Sun Ray has a width of 130 units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
language.shardDescription: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova, and slows affected enemies by .

language.lore: SQAWRK!
description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
notes: Sun Ray allows Phoenix to move over cliffs and trees.

description: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable 2% Miss chance per second. Lasts 4 seconds.

language.lore: The solar crucible of a Supernova may be fatal, yet from its flames arise new beacons to wander infinity.
description: The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6.0 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
language.aghanimDescription: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

language.lore: PKAWW! BOOM
description: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

language.lore: SCREE!
description: Immediately cancels the dive.

language.lore: CHIRP!
description: Immediately stops the Sun Ray.

language.lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.
description: CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Affects invulnerable units.

language.lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics.  Other kinds of suffering however...
description: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.

language.lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.
description: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
notes: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

language.lore: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.
description: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom).

language.lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.
description: Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.
DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes False Promise to have a  second fade delay invisibility and grants the ally  bonus Spell Damage and  reduced Base Attack Time.

language.lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
description: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4 / 6 / 8 / 10% of their current health each second.
notes: Enemy units can only receive the Arctic Burn debuff once per cast.
This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to 0.1.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Removes limit on number of attacks per target. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

language.lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.
description: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 28 / 32 / 36 / 40%.
notes: The primary projectile moves at 1200 movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

language.lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.
description: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
language.shardDescription: When Cold Embrace ends, a Splinter Blast goes off at that location, hitting enemies within  range. Reduces cooldown by  seconds.

description: When a Shrine of Wisdom grants experience to allies, Winter Wyvern shares the knowledge with her entire team, granting 20% of the experience to each of the 3 heroes that did not collect the initial bonus.

language.lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
description: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units.
notes: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

language.lore: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.
description: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
language.aghanimDescription: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

language.lore: Time and space are of little consequence to one as old as Zet.
description: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The magnetic field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field.

language.lore: Lesser fragments of Zet's original self.
description: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.
language.shardDescription: When Spark Wraith activates, a secondary Spark Wraith will fuse to the next closest target that deals 0 damage. Increases Spark Wraith search radius.

description: Upon activating any rune, gain the Regeneration Rune buff for 4.0s.
notes: Has 67% duration when activating a Bounty or Water rune.

language.lore: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.
description:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and special Tempest Double versions of his spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
notes: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

language.lore: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.
description: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
notes: Does not affect spell-immune enemies.
language.shardDescription: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with 35 of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

language.lore: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.
description: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3.0 seconds. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.

language.lore: Leaping from the safety of cover into the midst of his enemies, Sun Wukong attacks without mercy.
description: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.

language.lore: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.
description: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

language.lore: Watch out for that tree.
description: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.
language.shardDescription: Mischief has a shorter cooldown, longer invulnerability period, and disjoints projectiles.

language.lore: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.
description: Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack and only target heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.
notes: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
language.aghanimDescription: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

description: Reverts Monkey King's shape to his original form.

language.lore: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...
description: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
notes: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

language.lore: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.
description: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3.0 seconds.
notes: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
language.aghanimDescription: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

language.lore: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...
description: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
language.shardDescription: Cursed Crown creates  brambles in a  radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

language.lore: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.
description: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
Whenever a skill makes Dark Willow become untargetable, she gains + 150% HP Regen and + 150% Mana Regen while in that state.

language.lore: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...
description: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

language.lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
description: Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.
Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

language.lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.
description: Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.
Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75 damage.

language.lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.
description: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

language.lore: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.
description: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

language.lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...
description: Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% additional magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land.
Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier 1.0s to reach full roll speed.

language.lore: Donté Panlin stops when he pleases.
description: Halt!
Ends Pangolier's Roll Up early.
Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

language.lore: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.
description: Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits. Applies Ink Trail on hit.

language.lore: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.
description: Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.
Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

language.lore: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.
description: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
language.shardDescription:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal  more damage and heal the target for  of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.
description: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 95%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
Triggers an existing Ink Swell.

language.lore: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...
description: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

description: Adds an effect to Grimstroke's attacks that causes enemy heroes to leave a trail of ink behind them for 4.0s.
notes: Provides vision over affected heroes.

language.lore: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.
description: Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
notes: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
Acorn Shot benefits from attack range bonuses.

language.lore: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.
description: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
notes: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

language.lore: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.
description: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. All sources of evasion are doubled for the duration.
notes: Redirect chance from Mistwoods Wayfarer is also doubled for the duration.

language.lore: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.
description: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

language.lore: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.
description: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

language.lore: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.
description: Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero. The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after 3.0 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after 5.0 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

language.lore: Fire!
description: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.
Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

language.lore: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.
description: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
language.shardDescription: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 0 damage to them every second in both paths.

language.lore: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.
description: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
notes: Call of the Void will never spawn Aether Remnants in the Outer Ring.

language.lore: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.
description: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
language.aghanimDescription: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain  charges.

description: Void Spirit gains 25% more HP regen from Strength, armor from Agility, and mana regen and magic resistance from Intelligence.

language.lore: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.
description: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
notes: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

language.lore: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.
description: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage, Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.

language.lore: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.
description: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
notes: The cookie projectile has a speed of 1200.
language.shardDescription: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40 impact damage to the landing destination.

language.lore: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.
description: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
notes: Sets base attack time to 1.0s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.

language.lore: SHLORP!
description: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to  seconds.
notes: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.

language.lore: SPITTOOO!
description: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

language.lore: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.
description: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
notes: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of 0.8 and maximum travel time of 2.0.

description: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals 30% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a 25 chance of a glancing shot, dealing 60% damage.
notes: Ricochet II attacks cannot miss.

language.lore: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.
description: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
notes: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
language.shardDescription: Spear of Mars impales up to 1 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

language.lore: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.
description: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

language.lore: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.
description:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at Mars's allies towards Mars instead.
notes: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
language.aghanimDescription: Creates  invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

description: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he and his allies are outnumbered by enemy heroes in 700 radius.

language.lore: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.
description: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.

language.lore: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.
description: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1.0 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

language.lore: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
description: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves more than 500 units away.
language.aghanimDescription: Escape Act has  charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies in an  radius take  damage.

language.lore: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.
description: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

language.lore: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.
description: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.

language.lore: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.
description:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.
*CRACK*

language.lore: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
description: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
notes: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of 215 for the duration of the ability and takes a brief 0.2s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by -100% for 0.12s.
language.shardDescription: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity, 50% magic resistance, and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 0 down to a minimum of 215.

language.lore: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.
description: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
notes: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.

language.lore: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
description: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within 650 units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for 50% of the amount.
notes: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Lifesteal Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

description: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.
Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day.

language.lore: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.
description: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map, damaging enemies and healing allies with each pulse. After a short duration, she flies to the target location, dealing additional damage and stunning enemies upon landing. Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
notes: Pulse interval is 0.5s.
Total flight duration is 1.7 seconds of channel time + 0.8 of flight time.
Cannot be cast without the Hammer.
language.aghanimDescription: Increases Solar Guardian's heal per pulse. Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for s after landing.

language.lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.
description: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

language.lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
description: Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies in a 300 radius where she lands.
The ally receives 15 / 20 / 25 / 30% bonus movement speed for 4.0s.
notes: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
language.shardDescription: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

language.lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.
description: Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

Marci protects an allied hero. For 6.0s, the ally also gains 75 of lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Whenever the ally attacks or is attacked by an enemy, Marci counter-attacks that target if they are within her attack range plus 125.
notes: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a 40% penalty against creeps.
Marci's counter-attack has a 0.45s cooldown.

language.lore: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.
description:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
notes: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of 1.0 second.

language.lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.
description: Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2.0s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.
Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
notes: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
language.aghanimDescription:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by  seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for  seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.
description: Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him.
Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

language.lore: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
description: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.

language.lore: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.
description: The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.
When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
notes: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
language.aghanimDescription: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases  waves of  projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

language.lore: AGAIN WITH THE ROCKS!
description:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
Begins the rush to the specified location.

language.lore: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.
description: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.
Primal Beast deals 40% more damage to buildings.

language.lore: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.
description:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1.5x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
language.aghanimDescription: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

language.lore: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
description: Summons a group of 4 revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.

language.lore: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.
description: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
notes: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus 175.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.

language.lore: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
description:
Muerta transforms, becoming immune to physical damage. All of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and Muerta gains bonus attack damage and phased movement.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
language.shardDescription:
Muerta gains  Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains 2 spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.

description: Muerta can always attack when she is ethereal. Muerta can always attack ethereal targets. When attacking ethereal targets, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage.

language.lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.
description: Kez slashes forward in a line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
notes: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

language.lore: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.
description: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

language.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
description:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
language.shardDescription: Kez lifesteals 0 from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

language.lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
description:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.
language.aghanimDescription:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

language.lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
description:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel, remaining immune to magic damage for the remainder of the cast time and the duration of the slashes.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
notes: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to 20% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

language.lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
description: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
notes: Does not work on buildings.

language.lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
description: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
notes: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

language.lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
description:
Kez's attacks and abilities with the Sai have a chance to Mark enemies. The next attack or ability damage from Kez will stun the enemy and deal a critical strike, consuming the buff.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 2.0 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned and gains a stronger Mark that stuns for longer and deals 4% * Target Hero Level bonus critical strike.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

language.lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
description: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
Stop blocking physical attacks.

language.lore: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.
description: Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.
Dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

language.lore: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.
description: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

language.lore: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.
description: Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.
When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within 2000 units of each other.

description: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
language.shardDescription:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

language.lore: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
description: Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
notes: Items can be used while in this mode.
language.aghanimDescription: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time. On beats when he strums two songs, Largo deals 0 + 0 magic damage per Groovin' stack to nearby enemies.
attributes: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK: 1 / 1.5 / 2

language.lore: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'
description: Largo plays a song that increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

language.lore: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'
description: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

language.lore: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'
description: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
